semantic_note: The v1 continuation schema stores only previousShotRevisionId and endFrameAssetId. It contains no source-take/frame-derivation relation. The reviewed validation therefore proves the strongest contract-supported relation: selected-plan adjacency, project ownership, and existence of the pinned asset. The worker report explicitly records this limitation; it is not a new blocker for this commit.
